title: Trees and timelines drawn from nested details and lists
blurb: Five more controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a plant family, a folder of files and a shop's floor guide as nested details in one picture, an amaryllis that grows along a range, and a kiln's firing programme on a liquid crystal display.
question: Can a branch in the middle of one element's picture be drawn opening and closing, when only the whole tree can be drawn?
result: Yes. The canvas draws the whole tree once for each row, clipped to the row and moved by what the closing branch has given back: 130 ms after a click a row laid out 139 units down was drawn at 87.9, and at rest the tree went back to one draw. Hit regions stay at the layout positions during the move. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
